arguments.summary: Investigated the connection pool refresh and found no direct correlation with the p99 latency spike. The ingress idle timeout was adjusted, and the certificate alert was resolved. The cron job drift issue was also addressed. The failed-jobs backlog has been growing, and 47 malformed rows in the failed_jobs table were identified and deleted, unblocking the retry queue.
arguments.recommended_next_step: Monitor the retry queue and the failed_jobs table to ensure that similar issues do not occur in the future. Also, review the connection pool configuration to ensure it is optimized for the current workload.
